title: Better highlight the airflow docs search navigator
body: Personally I saw myself squinting my eyes when I was trying to use the navigator. So I attempted to make it a bit more visible/make the highlight slightly better. I chose the colors based on what I perceived to be best for me but didn't go too far to select something extremely different.
